added.member: UI: CSS isolation and group blending
added.summary: A document element with mix-blend-mode composites with its subtree as one group through the blend (CSS Compositing 1 §3.2), and `isolation: isolate` makes an element a group its descendants' blends stay inside. og-render reads a copy of a UI layer drawn so far for the blends inside it, applies the spec's backdrop alpha, and composites a layer through its UiShape's blend.

fixed.summary: Blends that read the destination inside a UI layer (a filtered, masked or material ancestor) draw instead of being dropped; a layer's composite honours its blend instead of drawing normal; multiply over a layer's transparent pixels no longer darkens them, and screen and plus-lighter keep the layer's alpha.
